```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Download and filter
library(tidyverse)

dataset_file <- file.path("Data", "health_quality_dataset.rds")
dataset <- readRDS(dataset_file)
dataset <- dataset %>% 
  filter(year > 2021) %>% 
  filter(age>14)
```

```{r}
# Recode variables
dataset <- dataset %>% 
  mutate(unmet_ind = ifelse(unmet_reason_1 == 1 | unmet_reason_2 == 1, 1, 0), 
         unmet_fin = ifelse(unmet_reason_3 == 1 | unmet_reason_4 == 1, 1, 0), 
         unmet_org = ifelse(unmet_reason_5 == 1 | unmet_reason_6 == 1 | unmet_reason_8 == 1 | unmet_reason_9 == 1, 1, 0), 
         unmet_ter = ifelse(unmet_reason_7 == 1, 1, 0))
```



```{r}
# Normalize Data
dataset_norm <- dataset %>%
  group_by(year) %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(quality_state, inc_eq_real_log, age, sat_health, reg_doctors_per10k, reg_health_exp_med_pc),  ~ scales::rescale(.) %>% as.vector) %>% 
  ungroup()
head(dataset_norm, 5)
```

## Socdem

```{r}
library(lme4)
m1 <- lmer(quality_state ~ as.factor(sex) + age + as.factor(d008_UROV) + as.factor(year) + inc_eq_real_log + (1 | region_name), data = dataset_norm)
summary(m1)
```

```{r}
m2 <- lmer(quality_state ~ as.factor(sex) + age + as.factor(d008_UROV) + as.factor(year) + inc_eq_real_log + sat_health + (1 | region_name), data = dataset_norm)
summary(m2)
```

```{r}
sjPlot::tab_model(m1, m2)
```

## Experience of Interactions

```{r}
m3 <- lmer(quality_state ~ as.factor(sex) + age + as.factor(d008_UROV) + as.factor(year) + inc_eq_real_log + sat_health + as.factor(unmet) + (1 | region_name), data = dataset_norm)
summary(m3)
```

```{r}
dataset_norm_exp <- dataset_norm %>% 
  filter(unmet == 1)

m4 <- lmer(quality_state ~ as.factor(sex) + age + as.factor(d008_UROV) + as.factor(year) + inc_eq_real_log + sat_health + as.factor(unmet_ind) + as.factor(unmet_fin) + as.factor(unmet_org) + as.factor(unmet_ter) + (1 | region_name), data = dataset_norm_exp)
summary(m4)
```

```{r}
sjPlot::tab_model(m3, m4)
```


## Regional Differences

```{r}
m5 <- lmer(quality_state ~ as.factor(sex) + age + as.factor(d008_UROV) + as.factor(year) + inc_eq_real_log + sat_health + reg_doctors_per10k + (1 | region_name), data = dataset_norm)
summary(m5)
```

```{r}
m6 <- lmer(quality_state ~ as.factor(sex) + age + as.factor(d008_UROV) + as.factor(year) + inc_eq_real_log + sat_health + reg_doctors_per10k + reg_health_exp_med_pc + (1 | region_name), data = dataset_norm)
summary(m6)
```


```{r}
sjPlot::tab_model(m5, m6)
```


## Interaction Effects

```{r}
m7 <- lmer(quality_state ~ as.factor(sex) + age + as.factor(d008_UROV) + as.factor(year) + inc_eq_real_log * reg_doctors_per10k + sat_health + reg_health_exp_med_pc + (1 | region_name), data = dataset_norm)
summary(m7)
```


```{r}
m8 <- lmer(quality_state ~ as.factor(sex) + age + as.factor(d008_UROV) + as.factor(year) + inc_eq_real_log * reg_health_exp_med_pc + sat_health + reg_doctors_per10k + (1 | region_name), data = dataset_norm)
summary(m8)
```

```{r}
sjPlot::tab_model(m7, m8)
```
